drafts.title: Clinical transfer drafts
drafts.description: Use this saved practice chart as an explicit source. Save cloud changes first. Radiology notes restate recorded findings; they do not interpret images.
drafts.checked: I checked the patient, source revision and clinical content.
drafts.attribution:
Patient: {{patient}} ({{number}}) · Chart date: {{date}}
Source chart: {{chart}} · Revision: {{revision}}
drafts.manual: Prepared in ToothOps for manual transfer. This does not confirm a PIMS upload or request a radiology interpretation.
drafts.reviewed: Reviewed and ready for manual transfer.
drafts.unreviewed: Save and review this draft before transferring it.
drafts.stale: The source changed. Check the updated chart and save this draft again before reviewing it.
drafts.unsaved: Save this chart to the practice cloud before preparing a persisted draft.

errors.schema: Draft storage is not available on this server yet.
errors.forbidden: You need current practice access to this shared chart. Private charts must be shared separately.
errors.stale: The chart changed. Reload its source, check the notes, then save and review again.
errors.conflict: Someone changed this draft. Reload the saved version before editing again.
errors.font: This PDF font cannot preserve every character. Copy the reviewed text instead; no characters were removed.
errors.source: Saved chart notes could not be composed. Enter and review your own notes using the displayed source.
errors.limit: This draft is too large for PDF export. Copy the reviewed text instead.
errors.unknown: The outcome could not be confirmed. Your text is still here; reload saved drafts before trying another change.

review.title: PIMS appointments
review.description: Archive or restore integration appointments, not clinical records. Charts, revisions and attachments stay in your clinical library.
review.noConnections: No PIMS connections are configured for this practice yet.
review.captureUnavailable: Automatic synchronization is not enabled for this connection yet. Existing display-only imports remain available.
review.empty: No appointments or issues in this view.
review.identityWarning: Accepting changes updates schedule metadata only. Patient, clinician and encounter identities cannot be changed here.
review.sourceArchive: Archived after an explicit source cancellation or deletion.

errors.schema: PIMS review is not installed on this server yet. Your existing charts are unchanged.
errors.forbidden: Your practice access has changed. Refresh your session before continuing.
errors.conflict: This appointment or its identity has changed. Refresh and review the current values before trying again.
errors.unknown: The result could not be confirmed. Refresh to check the saved state before making another change.

reasons.patient_unlinked: The source patient has no confirmed link.
reasons.clinician_unlinked: The source clinician has no current practice-member link.
reasons.link_version: A confirmed identity link has changed.

reasons.archived_requires_review: This appointment is archived. Restoration requires explicit review.
reasons.status_unknown: The source could not confirm this appointment's status. It remains unchanged.

extension.name: ToothOps PIMS
extension.description: Writes your ToothOps record notes into the open PIMS consult.

install.title: The ToothOps PIMS extension isn’t responding
install.body: Make sure the ToothOps PIMS extension is installed and enabled in Chrome, then try again. If you don’t have it yet, contact ToothOps support for the install link.

noTab: Open the consult in PIMS, then try again.
severalTabs: Several PIMS tabs are open. Using: {{title}}

state.notConsult: ToothOps can’t verify the active encounter, so sending is disabled. Open a supported consult or copy the notes manually.
state.notMedicalTab: Open the Medical tab of the consult, then try again.
state.locked: This consult is locked in PIMS. Open an unlocked consult, then try again.
state.combined: ezyVet is in Combined view. Switch to Standard view, then try again.

editedNotice: The note was edited, so it can’t be split back into its sections. It will be sent as one block.

copy.title: Copy to your practice software
copy.hint: Copy here, then paste into the correct patient and encounter. Copying does not save or mark this chart as sent.
copy.prompt: Copy this text, then paste it into the correct patient and encounter:
copy.copied: Copied: {{section}}. Paste it into your practice software and verify that it saves.
copy.plainCopied: Copied as plain text: {{section}}. Paste it into your practice software and verify that it saves.
copy.promptOpened: Use the copy dialog to select and copy the text manually; nothing has been sent.
copy.imageUnavailable: This browser cannot copy pictures. Use a browser that supports image copying, or copy the note text instead.
copy.failed: ToothOps couldn’t copy this content. Check clipboard permissions and try again. Nothing has been sent.

actions.diagnosticCopied: Diagnostic report copied. Paste it into your message to ToothOps support.

mismatch.title: Different patient?
mismatch.messageNumbers: The chart is for {{chart}} (number {{chartNumber}}), but PIMS shows {{ezyvet}} (number {{ezyvetNumber}}).

alreadySent.title: Already sent on {{date}}. Send again?
alreadySent.message: Sending again adds a second copy in PIMS.

results.title: Results
results.stampFailed: Sent, but ToothOps couldn’t record the send date on this chart.

errors.extension_error: ToothOps couldn’t reach the ToothOps PIMS extension. Check that it is installed and enabled, then try again.
errors.timeout: The extension didn’t answer in time. Check the PIMS tab and try again.
errors.no_tab: The PIMS tab was closed. Open the consult in PIMS and try again.
errors.not_writable: The consult can no longer be written to because it is locked, closed or the active encounter can’t be verified. Open a supported, unlocked consult and try again, or copy the notes manually.
errors.patient_changed: A different patient or consult is now open in PIMS, so nothing more was sent. Open the right consult and try again.
errors.field_not_found: This field isn’t on the consult page. Choose another field under Where it goes.
errors.editor_not_found: ToothOps couldn’t find this field’s text box. Check the field in PIMS before sending again. If it keeps failing, copy the diagnostic report for ToothOps support.
errors.popup_not_found: This field’s editing window didn’t open. Check the field in PIMS before sending again. If it keeps failing, copy the diagnostic report for ToothOps support.
errors.popup_not_closed: This field’s editing window didn’t close after saving. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.save_button_not_found: ToothOps couldn’t find the Save button for this field. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.save_not_confirmed: PIMS didn’t confirm the save. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.no_preferred_email: The client has no preferred email address in PIMS. Add one, or choose another field.
errors.image_not_accepted: This field doesn’t accept pictures. Choose a field that accepts pictures.
errors.invalid_image: The chart picture couldn’t be prepared. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.picture_failed: ToothOps couldn’t draw the chart picture, so it wasn’t sent.
errors.maybe_sent: Some fields may already have been written. Check the consult in PIMS before sending again.
errors.item_extension_error: Something went wrong while writing this field. Check the field in PIMS before sending again.
errors.item_not_writable: The consult stopped accepting changes because it is locked, closed or the active encounter can’t be verified, so this field wasn’t sent. Check the consult in your practice software before sending again.
errors.item_patient_changed: A different patient or consult was opened in PIMS, so this field wasn’t sent. Check the consult in PIMS before sending again.
